visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with two small braids, wearing a white puffer jacket and dark pants, walks energetically toward the camera in a crowded indoor facility with a glass ceiling. Numerous adults and children are visible in the background, some pushing strollers, amidst lush greenery and wooden beams. (2) The scene shifts to a dimly lit indoor enclosure with intense red lighting. The girl, now with a pacifier, looks up curiously at a small primate moving along wooden branches. A person in the background holds the girl securely. (3) The girl is shown in a different setting with brighter, natural light, standing near a large grey shoebill bird with a prominent beak. The bird is perched on a wooden log near an exit sign. The girl wears a blue sweatshirt with a cartoon dog print. (4) A fluffy grey cat with black markings, a manul, jumps onto a rock inside a glass-enclosed habitat. The camera follows its movements as it walks across sandy ground. Spectators are seen through the reflection of the glass. (5) At an outdoor-style pond area, the girl in the white jacket leans over a low stone wall to feed several ducks swimming in the water. An adult's hand reaches out to assist her with the feed. (6) A large white pelican stands on a stone ledge before taking flight over the pond. The girl and other visitors watch in awe as it flaps its large wings and glides across the water surface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced acoustic guitar strumming sets a cheerful atmosphere. A female narrator speaks with high enthusiasm and rising intonation. Background chatter of a crowd and the mechanical clicking of camera shutters are present as people move through an entrance. (2) The acoustic environment shifts to a more enclosed space with audible room tone. The narrator's voice lowers slightly, and a child's voice with high pitch and clarity is heard reacting to animals. Short, soft thuds from animal movements are discernible. (3) Rhythmic percussion joins the guitar BGM. Splashing water and the rustling of plastic bags are heard as feeding begins. The narrator interacts with the child using friendly, high-arousal vocal tones. Laughter and excited murmurs from bystanders are audible. (4) A loud whoosh and the sound of large wings flapping create a sudden transient peak in the audio track. The BGM swells as the bird flies. The child's voice becomes very loud and high-pitched in surprise, followed by the sound of water rippling. (5) The guitar music continues into a final transition phase. The narrator's voice remains energetic, concluding the sequence with a high valence. A soft digital 'pop' sound effect marks the appearance of final text elements on screen.
